blocks.summary: DaP-ICoT addresses static visual insertion and broken visual representation through DVTI and PVTG, reporting SOTA results and 72.6% token reduction.
The paper motivates ICoT, identifies static positioning and fragmented visual tokens as limitations, and introduces dynamic and precise visual thoughts.
DVTI estimates confidence using token-level logit margins and inserts a visual thought only when confidence falls below threshold tau.
PVTG uses SAM2 object segmentation, attention-based relevance scoring, and interleaved reasoning with a selected object image.
Experiments cover Direct, MMCoT, DDCoT, SCAFFOLD, CCoT, and ICoT across five MLLMs on M3CoT, ScienceQA, and MME.
Ablations, token accounting, insertion frequency, confidence changes, threshold search, and a qualitative case support the method claims.
Related work places DaP-ICoT among MLLMs, MCoT, ICoT, visual sketching, and visual prompting; conclusion restates adaptive efficient visual reasoning.
